name: Imperial Settlers: Empires of the North

categories.label: Victory Points on the track
categories.help: The score your marker shows on the scoreboard before the end-of-game bonuses below.

categories.label: Cards in your Empire
categories.help: One point for each card in your Empire, counting starting locations, Basic Fields, Field upgrades and conquered Islands.

categories.label: Pairs of spare Resources
categories.help: One point for each full pair of Resources left in your supply. Resources placed on cards do not count.

categories.label: Gold left
categories.help: One point for each Gold left in your supply. Gold placed on cards does not count.

categories.label: Locations in your Empire
categories.help: Number of Locations in your Empire. Scores nothing; the most wins a tie.

categories.label: Workers
categories.help: Workers you have at the end. Scores nothing; the most wins a tie after Locations.

categories.label: Cards in hand
categories.help: Cards left in your hand. Scores nothing; the most wins a tie after Workers.

source.rulebook_title: Imperial Settlers: Empires of the North rulebook

notes: Base game only; solo mode and expansions excluded. Read from the 1jour-1jeu.com copy of the English publisher PDF (identical text to the aadl.org copy). Player count 2-4 comes from the components list (2-4 player side of the scoreboard); the rulebook has no explicit player-count line. Edition other than the first printing not checked.
